# Do not interpret a packaged Rust crypto backend as a completed Matrix migration

1276 adds imported crypto API modules and updates owned event interfaces, but accepted MatrixAccount still calls initCrypto with a TODO to use initRustCrypto. It then starts the client and updates encryption/session state. Packaging rust-crypto modules and rewriting their dynamic import path does not prove the active backend has migrated. Retain this explicit historical/current boundary when planning another SDK update. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: chat/protocols/matrix.
